l1_connect_account.title: Bring the storage tenants nobody watches into the console
l1_connect_account.why: Applications and backups write to the tenant, but nobody sees its usage, settings or access, so a wrong setting stays wrong.
steps: List every tenant and endpoint the applications and backup jobs write to.
Connect each one with a read-only administrative key.
Confirm buckets, keys and usage show for each tenant.
l1_connect_account.success: Every tenant in scope reports its buckets, keys and usage.
